	Tutorial How-To							
								
	"This tutorial requires an API key for interaction. 

If you don't have an API key, you can sign up for one via the Anthropic Console or view our static tutorial answer key instead."							
								
	How to get started							
	"1. Make a copy of this sheet and save it to your personal Google Drive

2. Install the Claude for Sheets extension (it may already be installed, in which case, skip to step 3)"							
			a. Go to the Claude for Sheets extension listing					
			b. Click the blue install button
